Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase! The Kiwi players make their way out to the middle, followed by Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das. Matt Henry will start with the ball.

Right then! Bangladesh need 319 to win and it won't be easy against a strong bowling line-up. They would need to have a very good start. The Kiwis, on the other hand, would look to take a few quick wickets and get the third win in a row. Can Bangladesh make a fist of this? We will find out as the chase begins in a while.

Daryl Mitchell says it is nice to get the job done for his team and to get to a score that they can hopefully defend. Adds that he is used to batting in the middle order and he was looking to stay positive and put pressure back on the bowlers. Finishes by saying that it was nice of Mitchell Santner to come back for the third and give him a chance of scoring the hundred.

Bangladesh, on the other hand, were disappointing. They made such a good start as they picked up three quick wickets and did not let the Kiwis settle down. Rubel Hossain was the star while Taskin Ahmed was brilliant with the ball but after they got Latham out, there was nothing from the visitors. They were taken to the cleaners by the Kiwis and they have been left with a daunting target. And once again, they were let down by their fielding as they dropped far too many catches. Overall, a bad day in the field for the visitors.

New Zealand's innings were about two batsmen and two batsmen only, Devon Conway and Daryl Mitchell. They joined hands when New Zealand were in trouble after losing Tom Latham but both scored terrific centuries and helped the Kiwis reach 318 which is a daunting score. There was nothing apart from those two and New Zealand will be a very happy side with how the newcomers have gone about their business in this innings. Superb stuff.

Wow, what a performance from New Zealand. They did not have a good first 20 to 25 overs but since then it has been all them as they post a score well above 300 and they are well on top now. They will be very pleased with the effort and they should back themselves to defend this. Bangladesh, on the other hand, would be disappointed. They were let down by their fielding yet again and they have a tough job in their hands.

Mitchell gets his CENTURY! Outstanding innings and he would not have reached there if the throw was a little better. Low full toss on middle, Mitchell flicks it to deep square leg and takes off for a couple. The fielder throws a wayward throw back to the keeper and that allows Mitchell to make it in. NEW ZEALAND END ON 318 FOR 6.
Slower ball outside off, Santner plays it to the deep cover region for three. Mitchell back on strike for the final ball.
Full toss on off, Mitchell punches it down to long off for just a single.

NOT OUT! Mitchell is in by just! Moves to 97 with that as well! Low full toss on off, Mitchell drives it to long off and takes off for a couple. The fielder has a shy at the keeper's end. Rahim collects and whips the bails off. An appeal is made and the third umpire is called for. The replays roll in and they show that Mitchell is in.
An appeal for run out taken upstairs. It seems that Mitchell is short of his crease. No, he has made it.

NO BALL AND FOUR! He will take it however they come now. Mustafizur Rahman bowls this on a length, on his body as Daryl Mitchell attempts to pull it away but gets the gloves past the keeper for a boundary. Replay show that it was a front foot no ball and he will now face a free hit!
FOUR!  Another slower one and another boundary! This is a bit shorter, on his body and Daryl Mitchell flicks this behind square on the leg side for a boundary!
FOUR! Straight as an arrow and the man at long on has no chance! Slower one by Mustafizur Rahman , Daryl Mitchell picks it up early and thumps it down the ground for a four. 300 up for Kiwis.
Very full on off, Mitchell works it to leg side for a single. 16 runs from the over.
SIX! Bang! Mitchell continues on his merry way! Full toss on the pads, Mitchell smacks it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Mitchell Santner is in now.

OUT! CAUGHT! That sounded good but not good enough! Neesham had no other option but to go for the big ones. Good length ball around off, Neesham looks to go over long on but does not time it well. It goes towards Liton Das at long on who makes no mistake.
Top edge but safe! Short ball around middle, Neesham looks to pull but it takes the top edge and it goes towards deep square leg where it falls safely. A couple taken.
Full on off, Mitchell hammers it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Mitchell makes full use of the Free Hit! Full ball around off, Mitchell moves across and then paddles it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Very full on off, Neesham pushes it to third man for a single. No Ball signalled.
Slower ball on middle, Neesham looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the leg side. They take off for a single and make it in the end.
Fullish ball outside off, Mitchell drives it to cover for a single.
PLAY AND A MISS! Good length ball outside off, Mitchell looks to cut but misses.
Good length ball around off, Mitchell looks to swing it away but misses.
James Neesham comes out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN IN THE DEEP! Mustafizur Rahman gets the danger man! Devon Conway would be disappointed to get out a delivery which he could have deposited into the stands. Mustafizur Rahman bowls this one a bit full, Conway manages to get under it but middles it straight to deep mid-wicket. Afif Hossain takes an easy catch there. But what an innings this has been by Devon Conway. A very very special knock in front of his home crowd and he goes off to a standing ovation from the crowd, a well deserved standing ovation one may add. He came in when his team was in a bit of trouble and has powered his side to a good score.
Slower one by Mustafizur Rahman. Short and wide outside off, Daryl cuts it to deep point for a run.
FOUR! Look at the timing! Full ball outside off, Conway powers it through the cover region for a boundary.
FOUR! Creamed! Slower ball outside off, Conway waits for it and then drives it through extra cover for a boundary. This is now the highest stand at the Basin Reserve.
Full on middle, Mitchell works it to long on for a single.
Uppish but safe! Short ball around off, Mitchell looks to pull but it takes the top edge and goes to the third man region where it falls safely. A couple taken.
Good length ball on off, Conway heaves it to long on and crosses over for a run.
Yorker on middle, Mitchell drives it to long on for a single.
Rubel Hossain is back on.

OUCH! That must have hurt! Mustafizur Rahman bowls a low full toss outside off. Daryl Mitchell looks to slog it through the off side but gets the inside edge onto his foot. The ball rolls away and they take a single. 12 from the over.
Brilliant change of pace by Mustafizur Rahman. Bowls a slower one right in the slot of Daryl Mitchell. He looks to carve this through the off side but misses it completely.
Length ball on middle and Conway pushes this to mid on for a run.

FOUR! Ahhh this is very sloppy by Taskin Ahmed. This should have been a single but instead is a boundary. Short and wide outside off, Devon Conway cuts it past point and Taskin Ahmed comes across from third man to collect it. He makes a mess of it and the ball goes under his legs and to the boundary.
Good length ball, wide outside off and pulles down to the leg side for a couple.
FOUR! He can hit that shot all day! Short and wide and Devon Conway flays this to the backward point boundary.
Excellent delivery! Yorker outside off, Mitchell digs it back to the bowler. Taskin finishes with figures of 10-1-52-1.
Very full ball on off, Conway pushes it to cover for a single.
Full on middle, Devin punches it back to the bowler.

DROPPED! Another one put down! Bangladesh's fielding goes from bad to worse! Short ball around middle, Mitchell looks to pull but it takes the top edge and goes towards short fine leg. Mahmudullah goes back but fails to catch it. A single taken.
Full ball on middle, Mitchell heaves it to the deep mid-wicket region for a couple. 250 up for New Zealand.
Full ball on off, Conway pushes it to the off side for a single.

FOUR! Brilliant adjustment by Daryl Mitchell. Length ball right in his slot, he clears his front leg and waits for the slower ball and then just chips it over mid off for a boundary. The fielder from long on came across looking to stop it, but could not.
Length ball, outside off, Conway looks to pull it but gets the under edge towards short fine leg for a single.
Slower ball, on a length outside off and Daryl taps it to cover. They take a single.
Extra bit of bounce there. Mustafizur hits the deck hard on good length, Daryl Mitchell looks to carve this through the off side but the ball goes past the outside edge.
Short of good length, outside off and Conway pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short ball outside off and Devon Conway miscues the cut shot to point.
On middle, pushed to long on for a single.
FOUR! CENTURY! What a hundred from Devin Conway! He has taken international cricket like a fish to water. Good length ball outside off, Conway cuts it through point for a boundary.
Short ball down the leg side, Conway pulls but finds short fine leg.
Full on off, DC pushes it to mid off.
Full ball on middle, Devon flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Good length ball around off, Mitchell plays it to deep cover for a single.
Flatter delivery outside off as Daryl Mitchell cuts it to deep point and he will keep the strike.
Full delivery, in the line of the stumps, Conway drives it to long. The batsmen take a single.
FOUR! Easy picking for Conway, he seems to be in a hurry to get to his 100. Poor ball by Mahedi, short outside off and Conway nails the pull shot to the mid-wicket boundary.
FOUR! Brilliant placement by Conway! Tossed up ball, outside off and he sweeps it towards the fine leg boundary. Moves into the 90's with that shot.
Low full toss around off and Mitchell pushes it to long on for a single.
Flatter ball, wide outside off as Devon works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Full ball on the pads, Conway flicks it to the deep square leg for a single.
On the pads, Mitchell flicks to the leg side for a single. 100-run stand comes up.
TOP EDGE AND FOUR! Fifty as well for Mitchell! He is playing a very good hand here! Short around middle, Mitchell looks to pull but it takes the top edge and it goes over the keeper for a boundary.
Short ball on middle, Conway pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Full ball on off, Conway uses his feet and then places it over the point fielder for a couple.
Good length ball on middle, Mitchell nudges it to the leg side for a single.
Powerplay three time! Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the innings.
Can't find the gap this time! Mahedi Hasan bowls a fatter one on middle, Conway backs away and hits it straight to covers.
Short and wide ball outside off, Daryl chops it to backward point for a run.
Tossed up, outside off and Devon reverse sweeps it to short third man. They run a single.
FOUR! Brilliant execution by Conway! Mahedi Hasan darts this on off, Devon Conway slog sweeps it to the mid-wicket boundary.
Tossed up, on his pads and Daryl pushes it to long on for a run.
Misses out on that one! Full toss on his pads and Daryl Mitchell flicks it to square leg.
Full ball on off, Mitchell plays it to the cover region for a single.
On middle, played to long on for a single. 200 up for the Kiwis.
FOUR! Up and over! Brilliant shot! Full on the pads, Conway flicks it to the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Good length ball on middle, Daryl flicks it to the leg side and collects a run.
Outside off, pushed to the off side. Mitchell wants the run but is sent back.
Good length ball on middle, Mitchell pushes it down to long on and picks up a couple. Good running.
Soumya Sarkar has a change of ends.
Tossed up, outside off. Devon too attempts the reverse sweep but gets the under edge and the ball goes past the stumps.
Good bowling by Mahedi Hasan. Saw Daryl Mitchell coming down the track and shortened his length, Mitchell can only club it to long on for a run.
Tossed up, Devon Conway looks to  reverse sweep it but gets the bottom edge towards short fine leg for a run.
Tossed up, outside off, defended to covers by Conway.
Again a reverse sweep. Mahedi Hasan shortens his length, so Mitchell can only get it to third man for a run.
FOUR! He is toying with the bowlers now! Full ball on off and Daryl Mitchell reverse sweeps it over short third man for a boundary.
Mahedi Hasan back on.
On the pads, tucked to the leg side for a single.
On a length on off, Devon punches it to long on for a single.
Good length ball on middle, DM nudges it to the leg side for a single.
Outside off, chopped to third man for a single.
FOUR! How good is that? Full ball on middle, Conway walks across his stumps and then flicks it to the deep square leg region for a boundary.
Short on the pads, Mitchell pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off, Conway looks to drive it but gets the inside edge towards square leg. Dot ball to finish.
Short and wide outside off, Conway cuts it to extra cover.
Good length delivery, around off and pushed to mid-wicket for one by Daryl Mitchell.
Slower ball this time by Sarkar. Off cutter, pitches on middle and Conway looks to pull it away. He is early through the shot and is hit on the body, they run a leg bye.
A touch short and wider outside off, Mitchell cuts it to deep point for a run.
FOUR! Some power by Daryl Mitchell! Short and wide outside off and Daryl clubs it towards the mid-wicket boundary.
That's nasty! Full ball on off, Mitchell drives it hard straight back. It hits Mustafizur Rahman on his finger and it goes towards long on for a single.
Full ball outside off, driven to deep cover for a single. 50-run stand comes up. No Ball given. A Free Hit will follow.
On a length outside off, Conway punches it through the point region for a couple.
On off, defended to the off side.
Bangladesh have taken a review for caught behind! Let's see what happens.

NOT OUT! The Ultra Edge shows no spike and Bangladesh lose one of their reviews! Good length ball around off, Conway looks to defend but seems to have missed. Bangladesh appeal but the umpire is not interested. Tamim discusses with his teammates whether to take the review and takes it in the end. The Ultra Edge rolls in and it shows that there is no bat.
Full on middle, driven back to the bowler.
Good length ball on off, Conway defends it to point.
Mustafizur Rahman is back on.
Lets it go on a length, outside off and Daryl Mitchell moves across the line to defend it.
Full ball, on the sixth stump line and Daryl can only push it to mid off.
Slower ball, on a length outside off and Conway taps it down to third man for a run.
Short and wide outside off, Daryl creams this to deep cover for a run.
Good length ball, on middle and Daryl pushes it down the ground. The fielder at short mid-wicket dives to his left to stop it.
Fullish ball, on the pads and Conway clips it to deep square leg to cross over.

Drinks! New Zealand have recovered well since the previous drinks break and it is again Devin Conway at the thick of things. They did lose Latham but Daryl Mitchell has played well so far and New Zealand would hope that this partnership can continue. Bangladesh, on the other hand, had a golden chance to run out Mitchell but they did not take it. They would want to break this partnership as soon as possible.
Short on middle, pulled to mid-wicket.

Run out chance missed! The fielder fails to collect it cleanly. A golden chance for Daryl Mitchell! Good length ball on off, Mitchell defends it to cover and takes off for a single but Conway is not interested and sends him back. The substitute fielder runs ahead to collect and throw but fails to do.
EDGY! Good length ball on off, angling in. Mitchell looks to defend but gets a bottom edge which goes towards the keeper.
On a length on the pads, Conway flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
On a length outside off, guided to third man for a single.
This was bowled with some pace! Short delivery outside off, Mitchell throws the kitchen sink at it but misses.
Lets it go on a length, on middle stump line. Devon punches it off the back foot and the ball goes on to hit the stumps at the non-striker's end and deflects to mid on.
Fullish delivery, outside off and Daryl Mitchell pushes this to long on for a run.
Just short of short fine leg! Bowls a full ball, down the leg side. Daryl Mitchell clips it away but the ball lands just in front of short fine leg.
Short ball, drifting down his pads and Devon tucks it to fine leg for a run.
Full ball, outside off, Devon defends it.
Good length ball, outside off and Daryl punches it to deep cover for a run.
Full on middle, pushed to mid on.
Fullsih ball outside off, Conway guides it through point for another couple.
Great shot for a couple! Full ball outside off, Conway drives it through extra cover and picks up a couple before the fielder cuts it off.
Full on middle, pushed to mid on for a single.
FOUR! CLUBBED! Mitchell is showing his power here! Full ball on middle, Mitchell comes down the track and then hammers it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full and on off, Conway drives it wide of mid off for a single.
Rubel Hossain is back on. 6-1-29-2 are his numbers so far.
Lets it go on a length, outside off. Daryl Mitchell looks to work it on the leg side but gets hit high on the pads.
Bowls this full, on off and Daryl drives this to cover.
Short and wide outside off, Devon Conway works it down to third man for a run.
Full ball, in the line of the stumps and DM pushes this to mid on for a run.
Length ball, outside off and Daryl defends this off the back foot.
Short of a length, a touch outside off. Conway walks across the line and works it to third man for a run.
On middle, defended out.
Flatter on middle, tucked to mid-wicket.
SIX! That made a lovely sound of the bat! Tossed up on middle, Mitchell uses his feet and then whacks it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Around off, DC plays it to deep cover for a single. Conway reaches his fifty as well. This has been another good innings from the southpaw and his rise in international cricket continues.
Flatter ball outside off, punched to point.
Flatter ball on the pads, Mitchell flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Daryl Mitchell runs it past backward point to keep the strike.
Length ball, outside off and Daryl Mitchell pushes this to mid on looking for a run, but is sent back by Devon.
Full ball, on his pads and pushed to mid on by Daryl.
FIVE WIDES! Daryl Mitchell moves across the line and Soumya Sarkar fires this down the leg side. Mushfiqur Rahim cannot collect it and the ball goes to the boundary.
Length ball on off and Daryl Mitchell  defends this from the crease.
Good length ball, on his pads and Conway works this to square leg for a run.
Full ball, outside off and Devon drives this to mid off.
Loopy ball on middle, Daryl plays it to mid-wicket.
On the pads, tucked to square leg.
Full on middle, Devon pushes it to long on for a run.
Floated on middle, DM dances down the track and then works it down to long on for a single.
Flatter ball on the pads, Mitchell nudges it to square leg.
Loopy ball outside off, Conway drives it to deep cover for a run.
Good length ball, drifting down the leg side and Daryl Mitchell works it towards the vacant mid-wicket area for two runs.
Short of a length, outside off and Daryl Mitchell punches it to covers.
Good length ball, wide outside off and Daryl Mitchell defends it.
Short and wide outside off, DM cuts it towards deep cover for a couple.
Full ball, down the leg side and Daryl Mitchell looks to flick it away but gets the leading edge towards mid on.
Beaten! Lets it go on a length outside off and the ball goes past Daryl Mitchell's attempted defence.
Flatter ball on middle, Mitchell pushes it down to long on for a single.
Floated on middle, Mitchell is solid in defense.
On the pads, DM tucks it to the leg side.
Flatter ball on middle, Daryl works it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside off, DC drives it to deep cover for a single.
Floated on off, Conway uses his feet and then plays it out.
Length ball, outside off and Daryl Mitchell defends it off the front foot.
Full ball, outside off and Devon drives this to sweeper-cover for a run.
Good length ball outside off, Daryl punches it to deep cover for a run.
Fullish ball on off, punched to mid off.
Good length ball on off, Mitchell works it to mid on.
Daryl Mitchell comes out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! What an outstanding catch and Soumya Sarkar strikes off the very first ball! They have dropped a couple of catches but this is a brilliant one! Sarkar lets it go on a length, outside off and Latham hits it towards point, Mehidy Hasan is the fielder and he takes an absolute screecher diving high and to his left! A nice partnership was building up between the two and Bangladesh have struck at the right time.
Flighted ball on middle, Conway uses his feet and then flicks it to the deep on the leg side for a couple.
On middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Floated outside off, Conway looks to defend but gets beaten.
FOUR! Conway will not miss out on these freebies! Shortish and outside off, Conway cuts it through the cover-point region for a boundary.
Flatter on middle, Devin tucks it to mid-wicket.
On off, defended to point.
Slower through the air, outside off and Devon drives this past short cover to keep the strike.
Loopy ball on middle and leg as Tom Latham shimmies down the track to push it to long on. They pick up a run.
Short ball, outside off and Latham clips this towards deep mid-wicket for a couple.
A bit shorter on his stumps this time and Devon pushes this to long on to rotate the strike.
Full ball on his pads Latham punches this to long on for a single.
Tossed up on leg stump and Devon pushes this to long on for a run.
Flatter ball outside off, Latham cuts it to point.
On middle, punched down to mid on.
Flatter ball on middle, Latham uses his feet and then tucks it to mid-wicket.
Floated ball on middle, Latham uses his feet and then lifts it over mid-wicket for a couple.
Loopy ball on the pads, Conway works it to the leg side for a run.
Floated on middle, Latham nudges it to the leg side for a single.
Mehidy Hasan is into the attack now.
Mahedi Hasan fires this one on his pads and Devon Conway misses his sweep this time and is hit on the pads.
Slower through the air, outside off and Devon offers a solid front foot defence.
FOUR! That brings up the 100 for New Zealand. Tossed up, on his pads and Conway sweeps this past short fine leg for a boundary.
Tossed up, on his pads and Latham clips this to long on for a run.
Flatter ball, outside off and pushed to point.
Tossed up, Latham comes down the track looking to work it through the on side but gets hit on the pads.
A big over for the Kiwis comes to an end. Full ball on the pads, Conway flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! Conway is certanly in control of this shot! Wow, this guy is some player! Full on middle, Conway leans into it and drives it through mid on for another boundary.
EDGED AND FOUR! This one is off the edge now! Full ball outside off, Conway looks to drive but it takes the outside edge and it flies to the third man region for a boundary.
FOUR! Lovely from Conway! This shot just oozes confidence! Good length ball outside off, Conway guides it to the third man region for a boundary.
Full on off, Conway drives it back to the bowler.
Full ball outside off, pushed to cover.

Appeal by Mahedi Hasan but nothing from the umpire. Tossed up ball on middle, Latham comes down the track but misses the shot and gets hit on the pads. There was a strong appeal by Hasan but the umpire was not interested. Tamim considers a review but doesn't take it this time.
A touch shorter in length this time, outside off as Devon punches it to covers for a run.
Tossed up, on off and Devon defends it.
FOUR! Great use of the crease. Short and a touch wide outside off, Devon goes deep in his crease and cuts it between point and backward point for a four.
Flatter ball, on middle and Devon pushes this to mid on.
Tossed up, on off and defended to covers by Devon.
Good length ball on off, Devon taps it to the off side and takes a run.
Full ball on middle, Conway drives it straight back but Rubel does well to make a half stop.
Fullish ball on the pads, Devon flicks it to the fine leg region for a couple.
Full on off, Conway is solid in defense.
On a length on off, Latham pushes it to point and takes a run.
Full on middle, Tom pushes it to mid on.
Tossed up delivery, on middle and Conway comes down the track and turns this to mid-wicket.
Flatter ball, outside off as Latham pushes this past covers for a run.
Full ball, on middle and defended off the front foot.
Tossed up ball on middle, Latham looks to turn this on the leg side but gets a leading edge towards the bowler. The ball doesn't quite carry to Mahedi Hasan.
Tossed up, on off, Devon offers a defence but gets an inside edge to square leg for a run.
Flatter ball on his pads and Latham pushes this past mid-wicket for a run.
Mahedi Hasan comes onto bowl now.
Good length ball on off, Devon defends it out.
LEG BYE! On a length on the pad, TL looks to flick but it brushes his pads and goes to the leg side for a leg bye.
Full ball on off, Tom defends it to point.
Fullish ball on the pads, Conway plays it to the leg side for a single.
On middle, defended back to the bowler.
TOP EDGE AND FOUR! New Zealand will take it! Short ball around middle, Conway looks to pull but gets a top edge whcih flies over the keeper for a boundary at fine leg.

Drinks! It has been an exhilarating hour of play with Bangladesh doing really well to keep the Kiwis at bay. They have picked up three important wickets and they would look to continue the good work. The hosts, on the other hand, would need a solid partnership. Conway and Latham rescued New Zealand in the last game and they would hope that they can do it again.
Maiden for Taskin Ahmed and a well deserved one. He has bowled in the right channels and rarely bowled a loose one so far. Length ball, on middle and off and Latham offers a solid defensive stroke.
Fullish ball, outside off and Latham leans into it and hits it to mid-off. The fielder dives to his left to stop the ball.
Short of a length, on his pads and Latham glances this to mid-wicket.
Excellent line and length by Taskin Ahmed. Length ball, right on the fourth stump line. Latham moves across the line and lets it go.
Hits the deck on a length, but a bit wider outside off and Latham shoulders his arms.
Length ball, pitches outside leg stump and Latham clips it to mid-wicket.
On the pads, worked to the leg side for a single.

NOT OUT! Latham is in! Good running in the end! Fullish ball on the pads, Latham flicks it to the deep square leg region and takes off for a couple. The fielder gets to the ball quickly and throws it to Rahim who whips the bails off. The third umpire has been called for and the replays show that Latham is well in.
An appeal for run out taken upstairs. Let's see what happens.
FOUR! Too wide and Latham puts it away! Latham is away and running! Full ball outside off, Latham lunges forward and then drives it through cover for a boundary.
On a length on middle, worked to mid-wicket.
Back of a length ball on off, Latham pushes it back to the bowler.
Full ball outside off, Latham shoulders arms to it.

Beaten again! This is fast bowling at its best by Bangladesh. They are making full use of this greenish surface. Fuller ball this time, outside off and Conway attempts to drive this through the off side, only to get the ball go past the outside edge.
Beaten! Brilliant bowling by Taskin Ahmed. Length ball, just outside off and Conway is drawn into a front foot defence. He doesn't move his feet and the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
A fit fuller this time, outside off and Conway shoulders his arms.
Right on the money this time. Hits the deck on a length, right on the fourth stump line and Conway defends it.
Good length ball, a touch wider this time and Conway lets it go.
Length ball, outside off, Conway looks to drive it through the off side but gets the inside edge of the bat to square leg. They run a couple.
Tom Latham makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! And again, the dropped catch does not cost much to Bangladesh! Earlier, it was Henry Nicholls and now it is Ross Taylor. Good length ball outside off, Taylor looks to cut off the back foot but gets an outside edge back to Rahim who makes no mistake. Brilliant piece of bowling from Rubel Hossain.
FOUR! This time Taylor puts it away! Short ball on middle, Taylor pulls it to the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.

DROPPED! Another opportunity presents itself and Bangladesh put it down again! They really need to improve on their fielding. Good length ball on middle, Taylor looks to heave it away but gets it off the inner half towards mid on where the fielder makes a mess of it.
Shortish outside off, Taylor cuts it past the point fielder and picks up a couple of runs.
Good length ball on off, punched to cover.
On off, defended to point.
End of Powerplay 1! Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be stationed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Short and wide outside off, Taylor cuts it to third man to get off the mark.
Length delivery, very wide outside off and Taylor shoulders his arms.
Length ball, on middle and clipped away to mid-wicket.
Rapped on the pads! Length ball, outside off, Ross Taylor looks to work it on the leg side but the ball bounces a bit too much to hit him on the pads.
Beaten! Beautiful bowling by Taskin Ahmed. Hits the deck on a length, right in the corridor of uncertainty, the ball nips away a bit to go past Ross Taylor's attempted defence.

What a leave! My dear how did he get the confidence to leave this one? Length ball, pitches on off and nips back in sharply. Devon Conway leaves it but the ball goes just over his stumps. It seams so much that even Musfiqur Rahim doesn't collect it cleanly and they run a bye.
On off, blocked back to the bowler. Another successful over comes to an end for Bangladesh.
On a length on off, Taylor plays it to mid off.
On a length on middle, Taylor defends it back to the bowler.
Ross Taylor is the next man out in the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT AT MID ON! Guptill gets another start and finds another way to get out! This was a pretty innocuous ball and it was there to be hit but Guptill has mistimed it straight to mid on. Short ball around off, Guptill looks to pull but gets it off the top edge. It goes towards mid on where Liton Das takes the simplest of catches. New Zealand stuttering after a decent start.
On a length on off, Guptill pushes it to mid off for a dot.
Good length ball on middle, Guptill defends it to mid on.
Hits the deck on a length, on the fourth stump and Conway plays this to point. End of a successful over for Bangladesh.
Good length ball, outside off and Conway shoulders his arms.

FIVE WIDES! Free runs for New Zealand! Taskin Ahmed runs in and bowls a short one, but he misses his line as this is way down the leg side. The ball goes past the diving Mushfiqur Rahim and to the boundary.
Devon Conway is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! This time they hold onto one! Bangladesh will be relieved that the dropped catch does not cost too much. Good length ball, a touch outside off as Nicholls looks to punch it through the off side. He gets the outside edge and the ball travels to Liton Das at second slip. He takes an easy catch. Nicholls does not make use of a start.
Length ball, on the pads and Henry Nicholls misses his flick to get rapped on the pads.

DROPPED AND FOUR! Oh, you have to take these at International Level. Length ball, outside off, Nicholls comes down the track looking to slog it over the off side but gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies to the left of Mushfiqur Rahim behind the stumps but he drops it and the ball goes towards the boundary at third man.
Sharp bouncer! Taskin runs in hard and bowls a bouncer right around off, Nicholls looks to pull it away but misses and goes  to the keeper.
Short ball on middle, Guptill pulls it through the mid-wicket region for a couple of runs.
Back of a length ball outside off, Guptill punches it to point.
Good length ball on middle, Guptill looks to flick but gets an inside edge which goes towards the leg side for a couple.
On middle, worked to the leg side for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Nicholls cuts it through the point region for a couple.
BEATEN! This is a terrific start from Rubel! Good length ball around off, Nicholls looks to defend without any feet movement but gets beaten on the inside edge. Brilliant ball.
Rubel Hossain is into the attack.

Short and wide outside off, Nicholls comes down the track and smacks it over covers. He doesn't quite middle it and the ball is cut off by the fielder just inside the boundary line. They run three during the process.
Length ball, on middle, Nicholls looks to force it through the off side but gets the inner half of the back and the ball goes back to the bowler.

NOT OUT! Nicholls was in! Length ball on middle, Guptill looks to play it to the leg side but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls over to the off side and they set off for a quick single. The fielder from backward point comes charging in and hits the stumps at the striker's end. This looks close and the third umpire has been called for. The replays roll in and they show that Nicholls was comfortably in.
An appeal for run out taken upstairs. This looks close. The replays roll in and it shows that Nicholls was in.

FOUR! It was coming wasn't it? Short of a length, wide outside off and Guptill throws the kitchen sink at it. He gets the outside edge of the bat and the ball flies over the infield on the off side for a boundary.
Good length ball, outside off, Guptill pushes it to covers.
A bit of intent here from Guptill! Length ball on off, Guptill looks to go down the ground but gets the inner half of the bat back to the bowler.
Good shot! Fullish outside off, Guptill drives it through the cover region for three to end the over. Good solid start from New Zealand so far.
On a length on the pads, Martin flicks it to mid-wicket. No run.
Full on middle, Nicholls pushes it to mid on and takes a quick run. The fielder throws it to the bowler but Nicholls was in.
PLAY AND A MISS! Loose shot! Good length ball outside off, Nicholls looks to cut but misses.
Good length ball outside off, Nicholls shoulders arms to it.
Full ball on off, Guptill pushes it towards cover for a run.
Good length ball, on middlle and leg, Guptill clips it to square leg to keep the strike.

Beaten! Cuts him in half! Hits the deck on a length, pitches around off and then nips back in quite a bit. Guptill is stuck in his crease while offering a defensive push but the ball goes between his bat and pad to the keeper.
FOUR! Enough of blocking for Guptill. Length ball, a touch outside off and Guptill simply times it through covers for a four.

Quick run! Length ball on off, Nicholls shimmies down the track looking to smack it but miscues it to mid off. They run a quick single. The fielder runs ahead to collect but fails to do so cleanly and Nicholls makes it in easily.
A bit fuller this time, around off and angling away as Nicholls lets it go.
Length ball, outside off and Guptill jabs it to third man for a run.
FOUR! Timing was not great but enough to go for a boundary. Fullish ball on the pads, Nicholls flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary. First one of the game.
On a length outside off, Guptill guides it to third man for a run.
Nicely punched! Back of a length ball outside off, Guptill punches it through cover and picks up a couple.
Fullish ball on off, Guptill blocks it to point. This has been a cautious start so far.
On a length on off, Guptill gets behind the line of the delivery and then defends it to cover.
Full on the pads, Guptill flicks but finds the fielder at mid on.
Hits the deck on a length, the ball angles across the stumps and Henry Nicholls ends the over with a leave.
Good length ball, right in the corridor of uncertainty but Nicholls won't offer a shot.
A touch fuller this time, on his pads and Martin Guptill gets an inside edge towards square leg for a single.

Beaten! Beauty by Taskin Ahmed. Hits the deck on a length, right of the fourth stump line. Guptill looks to play it off the back foot but the away movement is enough for the ball to whizz past the outside edge.
Short of a length ball, on his body and Henry Nicholls clips it to square leg for a run.
Just short of point! Good length ball, around off as Nicholls looks to push it through the off side but gets the outside edge of the bat. The ball drops just short of the man at point.
Who will bowl from the other end? Taskin Ahmed it is.
A dot to end the first over! Good length ball outside off, Guptill watches it carefully and lets it go.
A quick single! On a length on middle, Nicholls pushes it wide of mid on and takes a quick run to get off the mark.
Back of a length ball on middle, Nicholls flicks it to square leg.
Guptill and New Zealand are underway! This is a good shot from Guptill! Full ball outside off, Guptill drives it through extra cover for three.
This time, Mustafizur goes full on off, Guptill lunges forward and blocks it out.
Mustafizur starts with a good length ball on middle, Guptill solidly defends it back to the bowler.
We are all set to begin the third and final ODI! The Bangladesh players make their way out to the middle, followed by Henry Nicholls and Martin Guptill. Mustafizur Rahman will start with the ball.

Time for the National Anthems! Both the teams are out on the field for their respective National Anthems. It is Bangladesh's 50th year of Independence and their National Anthem is up first followed by New Zealand's.

Ross Taylor says that his hamstring is doing good and it is nice for him to come back and play ODI cricket. Adds that Bangladesh will come hard at them. Mentions that he loves the ebbs and flows of ODI cricket and that playing with two new balls adds a bit of spice to the game. Finishes by saying that they will look to get through the first 5-10 overs of the innings after which it should be a good wicket to bat on.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Tamim Iqbal (C), Liton Das, Soumya Sarkar, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Mohammad Mithun, Mahmudullah, Mahedi Hasan, Mehidy Hasan, Taskin Ahmed, Mustafizur Rahman, Rubel Hossain (In place of Mohammad Saifuddin).

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Henry Nicholls, Devon Conway, Ross Taylor (IN PLACE OF WILL YOUNG), Tom Latham (WK/C), James Neesham, Daryl Mitchell, Mitchell Santner, Kyle Jamieson, Matt Henry, Trent Boult

Pitch report - Craig Cummins and Suzie Bates are there for the pitch report. Cummins says that there is green tinge on this wicket but there have been a lot of runs on offer in domestic cricket. Bates adds that the grass can be a little deceiving. The boundaries here are a little big. Bates says that the ball will seam but not for long.

Mohammad Mithun says that they created opportunity to win the match. Adds that today is a new day and hopes to perform well. Goes onto say that New Zealand is always challenging for them and he tries to do his bets and follows his plans.

Tamim Iqbal says that it looks like a good pitch for bowling. Adds that he was not angry at all after second game but was a little disappointed as they had their chances. Goes onto say that he would like New Zealand to come to Bangladesh where they can bowl their spinners more often.

Tom Latham says that New Zealand are going to bat first, says that it looks like a good surface and a lot of runs have been scored on this ground during the domestic season. Adds that they will look to get through the initial tough period and then build partnerships. Mentions that Ross Taylor has passed a fitness test and will play the game today. Finishes by saying that it is always good to play here and that the crowd is always great. Informs that Ross Taylor is back for Will Young.
Toss - Up goes the coin and it lands in favour of New Zealand, They have elected to bat.

New Zealand have Ross Taylor available for this game but they have not missed him so much as their batting has done a good job so far and they would look to continue the same in the final game as well. They might rest a few players and it will be interesting to see if they do so. Bangladesh, on the other hand, are sweating on the fitness of Mustafizur Rahman and they would hope that he recovers in time for this game. What will happen? Toss and team updates are not far away.

Hello and a warm welcome to the final ODI between New Zealand and Bangladesh. Yes, New Zealand have already won the series 2-0 and one might think that this is a dead rubber but with ICC World Cup Super League points up for grabs, no game can be a dead rubber. Bangladesh are second on the table and if they win, they might just go on top while New Zealand can go to second, replacing Bangladesh. So there is a lot to play for in this game and it promises to be an exciting one. Stay tuned for more.
